answer: Duplicating identities means buying and registering new tokens plus staking, so each fake sybil incurs real hardware and bond costs that scale linearly with attack size, making mass impersonation economically unviable. One concrete protocol: require each agent to stake a walnut-sized unique hardware token whose serial is registered at the zenith of a periodic identity epoch, then propagate a signed echo of that token across peers for cross-verification. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
